disposition_reason: Tables I and II print mean ± SD aluminum, arsenic, nickel, lead, chromium, copper, iron, selenium and zinc in 216 individual raw cow milk samples by area and lactation stage; cadmium and mercury were not detected.

study.design: Field survey of individual raw cow milk, drinking water and feed from farms near and far from industrial zones
study.origin: 24 dairy farms in Iskenderun and Antakya, Hatay province, Türkiye (12 within 15 km of industrial units, 12 beyond 15 km)

period.as_reported: 2021 to 2022; three lactation stages per cow

study.method: Microwave digestion with HNO3 and H2O2 (NMKL 161); ICP-MS (TS EN ISO 21424); water by USEPA 200.8
study.qa: not reported (no CRM, recovery or LOD stated)
